_comment: Copy to watchdog-config.json next to watchdog.ps1. Every key is optional; missing keys keep the built-in defaults.
_logFile: Where decisions are appended (trimmed to the last 200 lines past 200 KB).
_urlFile: Receives the current public URL after a repair (empty if never repaired). Delete or set to null to disable.
_offSwitch: If this file exists, every scan exits immediately. Absolute or relative to the script.
_cooldown: Never repair twice within this many minutes - stops restart storms on a flapping network.
_urlWaitSeconds: How long to wait for the tunnel to announce its public URL.
_bootWaitSeconds: How long to wait for the service to listen after a restart.
